images.title: Images
images.description: One entry per photo: {"imageUrl": "…", "maskUrl": "…"} with a mask image (white or opaque = remove), or {"imageUrl": "…", "boxes": [{"x": 690, "y": 410, "width": 180, "height": 320}]}. Optional "name" and "boxUnit" ("px" or "percent").

maskUrl.title: Mask for every image
maskUrl.description: One mask image used for all photos that have none (e.g. the same logo corner on every frame). It is stretched to each photo.

boxes.title: Boxes for every image
boxes.description: Boxes used for all photos that have neither mask nor boxes, e.g. [{"x": 85, "y": 90, "width": 15, "height": 10}] with box unit percent for a corner logo.

boxUnit.title: Box unit
boxUnit.description: Pixels of the original photo, or percent of its width/height.

format.title: Output format
format.description: Same as the input (PNG/WebP stay, everything else becomes JPG), or a fixed one.

zip.title: Also as one ZIP
zip.description: Bundle every result into images.zip when there are two or more.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
